257: ... And he didn't ask mercy for the world, and the water came, and all the people died. That's why it's called Noah's waters. Noah's water of course, because it was his fault. For he didn't ask mercy for the world.

For there wasn't a bad decree that was decreed on the world from above, that he didn't cancel. That is what is written (Samuel 2:23) "rules the people" the Holy One Blessed Be rules the people. And who rules the Holy One as it were? The righteous. For the Holy One decrees, and the righteous cancel it.
